## Biography

The Archer's Shadow. A name Cal pulled from pre-Federation navigation charts — back when explorers thought the region beyond the galactic core was cursed.

Thick interstellar clouds. Stellar density that makes deep-space navigation hazardous. Energy bursts from the center that scramble sensors and induce hallucinations in overwrought pilots. The last Alliance expedition to chart the Umbra Sagittarii failed. Hieronymus Halsey led it. They never returned.

During Distant Worlds 3, Jasmina Halsey felt the anomaly's pull coreward and spinwise — directly toward the Shadow. Lya's maps confirmed it. Hermine Delarue added the refinement branch to the expedition route, despite fuel concerns and the superstition of old spacers. "There be dragons," Cal had warned. The DW3 fleet went anyway. Some frontiers are not meant to be safe. They are meant to be crossed.
